transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm just... I'm so worn out. That's really what brought me in today. It's gotten to the point where even just walking from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I've been hauling lumber all day long. And it doesn't matter how much I sit down or try to sleep... resting just doesn't give me anything back anymore. I'm just completely drained.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things anymore, even activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah, that's... that's exactly it. I just don't care about any of it anymore. I used to really look forward to singing in the choir, or playing pickup basketball with the guys. I'd spend hours out in the garage working on cars, or, you know, grilling out back for the family on the weekends. But now... I just can't make myself care enough to even show up. I don't even answer their texts when they ask where I am. It's just all gone.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, pretty much every day. It's just... it's there all the time. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling right in my chest, and it just doesn't leave. Some days I just go sit out in the garage and cry... and I don't even know what started it. I just feel down all the time.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still?

Yeah, I definitely have. Everything I do has just slowed way down. It feels like my whole body is trying to move through deep mud. And it's... it's talking, too. Like, when someone asks me a question, I can hear them just fine, but it just takes me a really long time to actually get the words out to answer them. It's just a struggle to do much of anything.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or if it would just be better if you weren’t around anymore?

Yeah... I have. It's just... the thought keeps coming up that I should just be dead. And honestly, when I'm alone, it really scares me, because I start thinking that I might actually do something to make that happen.

Can you tell me if you’ve had any previous episodes like this before, where you felt this persistently down and hopeless for weeks or longer, or if this is the first time you’ve experienced something like this?
No, this is... this is the first time. I've never felt anything like this before. I mean, everyone has bad days, but this is completely different. It's just never been like this.

Have you ever had more than one period in your life when you felt down or depressed, with each period lasting for several weeks or longer, and with a clear period of improvement lasting at least two months in between them?

No, like I just said, this is the first time I've ever felt this way. I've never had any periods like this before in my life, so there hasn't been any time to have a break from it or have it happen again. It's just... it's all new to me, this whole thing.
